newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius bourse index eases Air Mauritius falls.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius bourse index eases Air Mauritius falls.

text.p: Falling Air Mauritius stock forced the Stock Exchange of Mauritius index Semdex 1.20 points down to 380.27 on Wednesday, brokers and floor dealers said.
Transaction totalled to 2.97 million rupees on 146,940 shares from 29.22 million rupees on 2,299,094 shares on Monday.

National carrier Air Mauritius slumped 2.30 rupees to 36.30 rupees on 2,050 shares. This week, local media reported forecasts of a huge fall in the airline's profits in the 1996/97 financial year compared to 1995/96.
"The figures have been damaging to Air Mauritius shares on the stock market," a broker said.
Mauritius Commercial Bank was stable at 88.50 rupees on 1,314 shares and State Bank of Mauritius climbed 20 cents to 12 but was not traded.
Hotel-based Sun Resorts was unchanged at 50 but was not traded, New Mauritius Hotels gained 20 cents to 37.20 rupees on 1,063 shares and Grand Baie Hotel remained at 49.
In the commerce sector, Ireland Blyth was stable at 16.20 rupees on 24,869 shares while Rogers was unchanged to 96 on 250 shares. Shell rose 10 cents to 20.10 rupees on 5,225 shares.
Industry-based Mauritius Breweries Ltd edged a rupee at 155 rupees on 800 shares and Mauritius Stationery Manufacturers was stable at 50.50 rupees on 718 shares.
In the sugar sector, Mon Desert Alma lost 2.0 rupees to 85.00 rupees on 1,182 shares and Mon Tresor Mon Desert was unchanged at 40 rupees on 1,741 shares.
Mauritius Development Investment Trust climbed 5.0 cents to 7.20 rupees on 39,500 shares and Fincorp remained at 72 on 1,057 shares.

Meantime, Gamma Civic bonds were admitted to the market on Wednesday. The industry-based company raised 160 million rupees through a public offer in May during which it sold 10.75 percent of its total holding through coupon bonds.
The secured bonds have a maturity period of five years with early redemption after three years -- at the company's option.
Gamma Civic bonds opened at 1,000 rupees. It dealt 1,001 units at 1007 rupees.
